fields.h1: Build a Shipping Form That Reaches the Dock Complete
fields.hero_description: Build a shipping form that asks what is in the box and which account pays, then sends each request to your shipping desk.
fields.features_heading: What the Form Collects Before Anything Ships
fields.features_subheading: A good shipping form lets the desk book the carrier from the request alone, with no follow-up email to the person who asked.
fields.feature_1:
Which account pays, on every request

The form requires the grant, cost center, or client code each shipment is charged to. The desk books the carrier knowing who pays, and the account stays with the request.
fields.feature_2:
Weight and contents, before it ships

Ask for the weight off the scale and the carton dimensions, plus a plain description of what is inside. Packers can attach a photo of the sealed carton, which saves with the request.
fields.feature_3:
Customs fields only for export

Pick a destination outside the US and the form adds a line per item, with an HS code, a country of origin, and a value. Domestic requests stay short, and export ones arrive complete.
fields.feature_4:
Your desk's rules, on each request

Write a rule once in plain English, such as sending heavy cartons to freight or holding perishables over a weekend. The form applies it to every request, and a new prompt changes it.
fields.feature_5:
A heads-up for whoever books it

Each new request can post to a Slack channel or arrive by email with the account and the ship-by date on it. A request nobody has booked by 4 p.m. sends a reminder to the desk.
fields.feature_6:
Every request in a table you own

Requests save to a database you own, with no cap on how many come in. Filter the dashboard by status or account to see what is waiting at the dock and what has already shipped.

fields.tab_content_1:
Frozen samples hold until Monday instead of a weekend dock

Researchers at Kessington University ship through one form that asks for a grant account first. The lab never ships frozen samples late in the week, when a delay could leave them on a closed dock. Marisol Etxeberria asks on Thursday to send 6 tubes of plasma, and her request tops Monday's mailroom queue.
fields.tab_content_2:
Any carton over 50 lb leaves by freight

Packers at Calderhook Supply weigh each carton and type the weight off the scale before sealing it. Anything over 50 lb goes to the freight desk instead of parcel pickup. Saskia Drummel's carton for order 20417 comes in at 58 lb, and the request moves to the freight desk's queue with her photo of the sealed box.
fields.tab_content_3:
Without an HS code, no export line submits

Nothing leaves Veldt Acoustics for another country until each line on the request has an HS code and a country of origin. Jovanka Ferreday in sales lists 2 amplifiers at $1,080 each and a cable set at $300 for a dealer in Rotterdam. The shipping desk gets both lines and the $2,460 total.
fields.tab_content_4:
A show date in, a ship-by date out

Booth crates at Pellmont Software ship 12 days before a trade show opens. Ruthanne Ksiazek in events enters a show that opens on November 19. The form sets the ship-by date to November 7 and posts the request to the #events Slack channel, where the person who books freight picks it up.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Shipping Form
fields.howto_description: Follow these 7 steps to build a shipping form, write its routing rules, and test it before the first real shipment goes out.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick one shipment from last week
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Write the desk's rules as sentences
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Choose who hears about each request
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose a shipment that took several emails to sort out. Write down every question the desk had to ask, such as which account pays or when the package must arrive. Each of those questions becomes a field.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Describe the form in plain English: who fills it in, what they enter, and where each request goes. Emergent builds the form and the database behind it, and a follow-up prompt changes any part of it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Put each rule in one sentence with its number, such as cartons over 50 lb going to freight. Rules the desk keeps in its head belong in the prompt too, because the form only applies what you write down.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Pick a Slack channel or an email address for new requests, and set a reminder for any request nobody has booked by the afternoon. Name one person for urgent requests so they never sit in a shared inbox.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Take the shipping form PDF off the mailroom door and put the link in its place, with a QR code for packers on the floor. Keep the old field names where people know them, and nobody has to relearn the form.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Submit one domestic parcel, one heavy carton, and one export with two lines. Check that each one reaches the right queue with every field filled in, then fix any rule that sent a request to the wrong place.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Publish the form and send the link to every team that ships. The free tier covers building and publishing, and each request lands in the database you own from the first submission.

faq_plan.a: A shipping form is the request a person fills in when something needs to go out: what is being sent, where it is going, how fast it must arrive, and which account pays. The shipping desk books the carrier from those answers instead of chasing the requester for details.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a shipping form?
faq_plan.a: Describe it in a prompt to Emergent's AI form builder: the fields each requester fills in, the rules your desk follows, and who hears about each request. Emergent builds the form, its routing rules, and the table that stores each request. If you have a shipping form PDF today, paste its fields into the prompt to keep the order people already know.

faq_plan.q: What should a shipping request form include?
faq_plan.a: Include the requester's name and team, the account that pays, and the recipient's full address and phone number. Then ask for the contents and their value, the weight and carton size, the service level, and the date it must arrive. Lab shipping forms should also ask whether anything inside is hazardous, because the desk needs that answer before it packs.

faq_plan.q: Can one shipping form template cover both customer orders and internal shipments?
faq_plan.a: No, keep them apart. A customer choosing a size and paying for delivery belongs on an order form, such as a t shirt order form, while a shipping form template is for the staff who pack and book what was ordered. When both forms live in one app, the shipping request can pull the address from the order instead of retyping it.

faq_plan.q: What customs details should a shipping form collect for an international package?
faq_plan.a: Collect a description, a quantity, a value, and a country of origin for each item, plus its HS code. Under the Harmonized System, traded goods are classified to a standardized 6-digit level. The desk uses those lines for the commercial invoice, one of the main documents used by customs in determining customs duties.

faq_plan.q: How do I send heavy packages to freight instead of parcel pickup with a shipping form?
faq_plan.a: Set the weight as a required number field and write the cutoff into a rule, such as anything over 50 lb going to the freight desk. On that branch, also require the pickup address and the number of cartons, because the freight desk schedules the truck from those two answers.

faq_plan.q: How should a shipping form handle perishable items?
faq_plan.a: Ask whether the item is perishable, how it must be kept, and the latest date it can arrive. Use those answers to pick the service level and to add cold packs to the packer's checklist. A bakery that mails its cookies can show the ship day on its cookie order form, where customers see it before they pay.

faq_plan.q: Who should approve a request on a shipping form before the package goes out?
faq_plan.a: Whoever owns the budget or the risk. Have the account holder approve any shipment charged to their account above a dollar limit you set, and have a trained person check any request that lists a hazardous material. On Emergent, the app emails the approver and saves the decision with the request in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Should a shipping form ask which account pays for the shipment?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Require the account, and offer a dropdown of valid grant numbers or cost centers instead of a blank box. Requesters then pick an account that exists rather than typing one from memory. Emergent forms have no response caps, and a busy month of shipments never closes the form.

faq_plan.q: Should a shipping form for export orders ask for the trade terms agreed with the buyer?
faq_plan.a: Yes, on export orders. Incoterms are internationally recognized rules that define the responsibilities of sellers and buyers in the export transaction, and each rule states which party carries out the customs formalities for the export. Copy the agreed term from the buyer's purchase order form; it tells the desk whether your side handles export clearance.

plan.angle: The top 10 for shipping form is carrier and agency customs pages (USPS, UPS, DHS), printed forms for sale, two university shipping request PDFs and two template galleries. None of them shows what happens after someone fills the form in: which account pays, who books the carrier, what a heavy carton or an export needs before it leaves. This page treats a shipping form as the internal request that reaches the shipping desk complete, with the desk's own rules applied: a lab's no-weekend hold, a warehouse's 50 lb freight cutoff, customs lines for export and a ship-by date for trade show freight. The FAQ answers what a shipping request form should include and the customs, freight and approval questions a person setting one up asks. Customer checkout and purchase orders stay on the order form and purchase order form siblings.

scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Shipping Form That Reaches the Dock Complete'; hero 'Build a shipping form that asks what is in the box and which account pays, then sends each request to your shipping desk.' carries the primary and leads with Build; how-to description 'Follow these 7 steps to build a shipping form, write its routing rules, and test it before the first real shipment goes out.' is one sentence. Meta title 'Shipping Form Builder for Internal Requests' matches the brief's internal-request angle.

intent.evidence: Builder-fit SERP with an internal shipping request angle: FAQ 3 lists what a shipping request form should include, FAQ 5 customs details, FAQ 10 Incoterms, step 5 replaces 'the shipping form PDF off the mailroom door', four worked request flows in the tabs.

specificity.evidence: Shipping-desk vocabulary throughout: 'grant, cost center, or client code', 'weight off the scale and the carton dimensions', 'a line per item, with an HS code, a country of origin, and a value', 'Booth crates at Pellmont Software ship 12 days before a trade show opens'.

openers.evidence: Every paragraph opens with a full sentence: 'Researchers at Kessington University ship through one form...', 'Choose a shipment that took several emails to sort out.', 'The form requires the grant, cost center, or client code...'.

craft.evidence: No sentence over 40 words, no tacked-on endings; longest sentences (FAQ 1, 4, 6 at 33-38 words) are flagged P2 only.

voice.evidence: Calm, concrete operator voice: 'A request nobody has booked by 4 p.m. sends a reminder to the desk.', 'Saskia Drummel's carton for order 20417 comes in at 58 lb'. Word repetition ('request', 'desk') is a note.

truth.evidence: FAQ 6 'since the freight desk needs them for the bill of lading' ties pickup address and carton count to the bill of lading; the quoted trade.gov span only says a bill of lading is a contract between the owner of the goods and the carrier, and the page says nothing about its contents. Other third-party facts hold: FAQ 5 HS 6-digit level and commercial invoice role, FAQ 10 Incoterms both match their quoted spans. Emergent claims map to prompt-build, alerts, database-owned, no-caps, code-export, free-start. Image numbers check: 2 x $1,080 + $300 = $2,460; 4 cartons, 3 to parcel pickup; November 19 - 12 days = November 7.

distinct.evidence: Internal shipping request page, distinct from shipping-address-form (label-order address collection); customer orders deferred to the order-form siblings ('A customer choosing a size and paying for delivery belongs on an order form'); no sibling primary in a heading.
